judge.reason: The memo states there is no P85 and refuses to invent one. It targets the review queue (wait vs. active split, WIP cap, review SLA), integration conflicts (trunk-based, disjoint write scopes), scope cuts, and critical-path protection. It rejects halving regression checks and rejects the +8 agents with a Brooks-style net-benefit check and explicit conditions to revisit, without treating them as eightfold capacity or insisting on a one-third-timeline cutoff.
